description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 07.09.2020 to 13.09.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It announces new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to modify how regulations are applied, specifically concerning the financial calculations required by customs law.
